problem: Premarket v2.3 used abs(change) for first-observation stage, early eligibility and +2/+5/+10/+20 crossings. Negative movers could therefore be labeled as upside WAKE_UP/PRE_IGNITION and contaminate Early-Capture Rate.

evidence.example: JUNS firstPMChangePct=-3.992 but firstObservationBand=WAKE_UP and earlyCaptureEligibleAtFirstObservation=true in the 05:08 ET snapshot
evidence.impact: false-positive benchmark labels and potentially invalid causal crossing timestamps for upside-mover evaluation

logic: use signed firstPMChangePct for upside thresholds
exclude negative paths from upside Early-Capture eligibility
introduce NEGATIVE_DISLOCATION stage for first observation <= -2%
remove positive crossing timestamps when current path is still negative
implemented.deploymentMode: post-heartbeat production reconciliation; no scoring threshold changed

benchmarkPolicy.before: upside labels could be generated from absolute price displacement
benchmarkPolicy.after: only signed positive displacement can qualify for upside early-capture cohort
benchmarkPolicy.promotion: data-correctness fix; not a champion scoring promotion

githubIntelligenceSweep.pattern: event-time append-only evidence, ASOF joins, dedup/out-of-order handling and final reconciliation separation
